intents.description: User seeks factual information, explanations, definitions, or understanding of a topic. Typically phrased as “what,” “how,” “why,” or “explain” queries. The goal is to receive knowledge or clarification, not to trigger an action or perform a task.
patterns: how do I train a model
what is the difference between ai and ml
give me a simple explanation of convolutional networks
why does training take so long
can you explain bias and variance
explain word embeddings in plain English
how do large language models work
what is the training data source

intents.description: User wants to locate, look up, or retrieve information from internal data sources or the internet. Includes queries about finding articles, documents, records, datasets, news, or references, where the primary action is information retrieval rather than explanation or execution.
patterns: search for recent news on climate change
search the knowledge base for onboarding steps
lookup the user manual for model X
search for images of golden retrievers
lookup quarterly revenue for Acme Corp
search the web for Python asyncio examples
find blog posts on prompt engineering
find legislative documents about privacy law
search internal docs for deployment steps
lookup stock price history for AAPL
search news articles about the product launch
search patents related to battery tech
find social posts mentioning our brand
search for tutorials on unit testing
find examples of UX patterns for onboarding
search for images of the Eiffel Tower
search for translations of this phrase
find news on interest rate changes
search for code that implements k-means
find grant opportunities in renewable energy
search for recipes with chicken and rice
lookup the documentation for React hooks
lookup clinical trial results for drug X
